exact_statement: For every finite-cube indicator g partitioned into actual connected components g_k, every nonempty proper physical block A of size r has signed raw-block cross term X_A=Lambda_A(g)-sum_k Lambda_A(g_k), and raw component excess equals X_A plus the averaged labelled child excess. Let R_k be physical component projections on A, mu_k=|R_k|/2^r, p_k=E g_k, p=sum_k p_k and Q_A=sum_k p_k log2(1/mu_k). Then Lambda_A(g_k)>=2p_k log2(1/mu_k) and E_A(g_k)>=p_k log2(1/mu_k)/2 without Cartesian structure. If the projections are disjoint, Gamma_A=[B_A(g)+(2/ln2)E_A(g)-sum_k Lambda_A(g_k)]_+ bounds the raw component excess and is at most (2/ln2)E_A(g)+[rp-2Q_A]_+. In the class Q_A>=rp/2 the interface is paid at (2/ln2)E_A(g), E_A(g)>=rp/4, and physical raw-ratio criticality forces Rraw<=4+2/ln2. For f=1-2g, physical sign-ratio criticality plus p>=p0>0 forces H/I<=2/ln2+1/p0; dimension-minimal positive H-KI violations are excluded at K>=2/ln2+1/p0. Brain45 sign phi over all126 proper cuts is uniquely minimized at mask15, and its raw phi is minimized exactly at masks3,5,6,9,10,12; strict sign own-ratio descent holds. No universal separator or density admission is asserted.
